periods.public: The group analyzes the initial statements from the previous day, looking for inconsistencies or unusual behavior. Some participants express suspicion towards those who were overly quiet or evasive, while others defend their own transparency. The discussion shifts to identifying who might be hiding information, with a focus on logical deduction rather than personal attacks.
